frameAdmission.policy: Acknowledge every observed CDP frame; retain strictly increasing finite timestamps. Omit and log invalid, duplicate, backward, or post-stop events. Never sort or rewrite retained timestamps.

capture: Chromium CDP screencast with real frame timestamps; no virtual time or state writes
